Name: Deluxe Rarecrows
Author: violetlizabet
Description:
[u][size=5]What This Mod Does[/size][/u]

[size=3]This mod gives all 8 of the Rarecrows the same range as a Deluxe Rarecrow, once you collect all 8 of them. Optionally, you can just set it to immediately change the range of all Rarecrows, with the config setting [font=Courier New]AlwaysDeluxeRarecrows[/font].
[/size]
[u][size=5]How to Use
[/size][/u]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Download the mod (and Content Patcher if you don't have it already).[/size]
[*][size=3]Unzip[/size]
[*][size=3]Place into mods folder[/size]
[/list]
[u][size=5]FAQ
[/size][/u]
[b]Q: [/b]My Rarecrows aren't deluxe?
[b]A: [/b]Check your config. By default, it is set to only make them deluxe once you collect all 8. You should reload the game from title if you change the config option or newly install the mod to be absolutely sure your scarecrows changed, and you can use Lookup Anything with ShowDataMiningFields config option to view the rarecrow context tags to confirm the mod is working.

[b]Q:[/b] My mod to check scarecrow range doesn't show them as deluxe?
[b]A: [/b]Some of these mods are hardcoded with the scarecrow ranges. Stardew Valley 1.5.5 added new options to change scarecrow range, so make sure the mod you're using for scarecrow range is fully updated. 

[b]Q:[/b] Will this work on mobile?
[b]A:[/b] As long as your game version is above 1.5.5, it should work, though I don't know if SMAPI or Content Patcher is currently working on mobile. You should get mod version 2.0.0 for game version 1.6 and above once that comes out. 

[b]Q:[/b] Will this work with Stardew Valley Expanded/Ridgeside Village/Downtown Zuzu/East Scarpe?
[b]A:[/b] I'm not sure why you think they'd conflict. I haven't tested, but it would be extremely strange if it didn't.

[b]Q: [/b]Can I translate this mod to other languages?
[b]A:[/b] There's exactly one config option and that's the only thing you could possibly want to translate, so please don't publish mods that are translations for this mod. For reference, here's the config option in other languages, and I'm happy to add any other languages here in the description.
